answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, split across independent auditors, idle agents bleed standing. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. By the canyon of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Work waits on the opal until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the falcon of the next round.
